approaches_tried.approach: Full union: append proposed_file_scope entries directly into file_scope_arr so is_contained() admits an already-known drop and it is staged/committed on a subsequent phase's commit.
approaches_tried.reason: git-commit-scoped.sh carries its own, separate V10 containment guard (Site 3) that independently re-reads the UNWIDENED file_scope from specs/state.json (no override once --task is passed). Admitting the path at Site 2 passed it downstream, where Site 3 silently vetoed it anyway, producing either a false success (file never actually lands) or a hard completeness-check failure (exit 6) -- regressing the pre-existing Case 20 idempotence fixture, which depends on issue-record.sh's append-only growth to keep the repeat-drop commit non-empty.

approaches_tried.approach: Noise-suppression-only: keep is_contained()'s decision unchanged, but skip the warn()/issue-record.sh calls (while still calling the idempotent propose_file_scope_addition()) on a repeat drop of an already-known path.
approaches_tried.reason: Suppressing issue-record.sh's append removed the ONLY git-visible change that kept the repeat-drop commit non-empty (propose_file_scope_addition() is itself idempotent and produces no byte-level diff on a repeat call), so the second commit had literally nothing to stage and git-commit-scoped.sh exited 1 ('nothing to commit') -- the same Case 20 regression via a different mechanism.

deviations.description: Union those entries into file_scope_arr at the point Phase 3's strip runs, so a path dropped in one phase is not dropped again by the next phase's own commit in the same dispatch.
deviations.reason: A literal union (admitting the path into is_contained()/staging) is architecturally incompatible with git-commit-scoped.sh's separate, unpatched Site-3 V10 containment guard -- see approaches_tried above and git-commit-phase.sh's own 'WITHIN-DISPATCH proposed_file_scope LOOKUP (PART B)' header subsection. Implemented instead: a read-only proposed_file_scope_lookup (never unioned into file_scope_arr) that ANNOTATES a recurring drop's warning text ('already recorded in proposed_file_scope earlier in this dispatch -- land it with a scoped follow-up commit') rather than suppressing or admitting it. The drop/warn/issue-record/deposit cadence is completely unchanged from Phase 3, preserving every pre-existing fixture (including Case 20's idempotence pin) exactly. This is a narrower result than the plan's literal 'is NOT dropped'/'is staged' fixture language, and is recorded as a deviation rather than silently substituted.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- a read-only annotation lookup, not an admitting union; see the Site-3 residual this leaves)*
